'''Jeremy Virgil''' won the [[1997 Kashyyyk Regionals (Boston)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"I turn 18 December 4. I enjoy swimming, water polo, paintball, and the occasional game of Star Wars CCG and Highlander (the original). It's not a good Rebel deck unless it has at least 2 Figrin D'ans."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/virgil.html Jeremy Virgil], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428124513/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/virgil.html Internet Archive]</ref>
